You can now always see when your screen will sleep again, in either mode. If you keep it on with no timer, Screen On reminds you now and then so a forgotten session doesn't drain your battery.

## New

- **Notification in Timeout mode.** Timeout mode now shows the same quiet notification as Wake lock mode: when the screen will turn off, a live countdown, and a **Turn off** button. Before, nothing showed once you left the app.
- **Still-on reminder.** With ∞ (until you turn it off) picked, a reminder comes every 2 hours, for example *"On for 4 hours with no timer."* Tap **Turn off** right on it. It never wakes your phone: if the phone was asleep, you get one reminder when you next use it. To mute it, turn off *Still-on reminders* in the app's notification settings.
- **Notification permission, asked once.** On Android 13 and newer, Screen On asks to show notifications the first time you turn it on, in either mode. Both modes work the same if you say no; you just won't see the status or reminders.

## Changed

- On Android 14 and newer you can swipe away the Timeout mode notification. It comes back the next time you turn Screen On on or change the timer.

## Download

Get **`screen-on-v1.2.0.apk`** and install it over 1.1.0; your settings are kept. Requires Android 7.0 or newer. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.
